name: Jawa Timur Open 2024

venue.name: Malang Creative Center
venue.address: Jl. A. Yani No.53, Blimbing, Kec. Blimbing, Kota Malang, Jawa Timur 65118

information: Jawa Timur Open 2024 is the biggest rubik's competition in East Java, and has entered its 10th year after the first Jawa Timur Open was held. This competition will be held at the Malang Creative Center, 5th floor, room "Cinema 1". This competition is open to the public and there is a special podium for students. For other information, you can see the other tabs. ----- Jawa Timur Open 2024 merupakan kompetisi rubik terbesar di jawa timur, dan telah memasuki tahun ke 10 setelah Jawa Timur Open pertama dilaksanakan.
